HOW THIS PREVIEW WORKS

Begin with a memory.

  1. Write. Add a name and a memory you would like to preserve.
  2. Preview. Read your tribute and return to edit it whenever you need.
  3. Keep. Download a text copy to your device.

This template keeps your draft on the current page until reload. It has no photo upload, hosting, or sharing service connected.

A FEW HELPFUL DETAILS

Take your time.

Where does my draft go?

It stays in this page’s memory. Nothing is uploaded, published, or saved to browser storage. Download a copy before reloading or closing the page.

Can I change it later?

Use Edit tribute before downloading. Your downloaded text file can also be edited with any text editor.

Can I add photos or invite family?

Those services are not connected in this template. No photo upload or invitation is sent.
